name: produce-html-page
title: Produce HTML Page
description: Generate a static HTML page from a spec: design → implement → verify. Generic and reusable for any HTML page type.
author: SolSolis-Sys

inputs.name: PAGE_NAME
inputs.description: Identifier / filename for the page (e.g. submit, index, dashboard)

inputs.name: PAGE_DESCRIPTION
inputs.description: One-paragraph description of what the page does and who uses it

inputs.name: TARGET_PATH
inputs.description: Absolute path where the HTML file must be written

inputs.name: FEATURES
inputs.description: Comma-separated list of features/sections to include (e.g. form,json-viewer,nav,footer)

agents.prompt: Design the structure of a HTML page named '{{PAGE_NAME}}'. Purpose: {{PAGE_DESCRIPTION}}. Features to include: {{FEATURES}}. Produce: (1) semantic HTML5 structure outline, (2) list of CSS classes needed, (3) list of JS interactions required, (4) accessibility requirements (WCAG 2.1 AA). No code yet — design only.

Implement the complete HTML page based on the designer's spec. Target: {{TARGET_PATH}}. Requirements: (1) single self-contained HTML file, (2) embedded CSS in <style> tag, (3) embedded JS in <script> tag, (4) no external CDN dependencies, (5) responsive mobile-first, (6) accessible (aria labels, semantic tags). Features: {{FEATURES}}. Write the complete file to {{TARGET_PATH}}.

Verify the HTML page at {{TARGET_PATH}}. Check: (1) file exists and is readable, (2) valid HTML5 structure (doctype, head, body), (3) all FEATURES present: {{FEATURES}}, (4) no broken <script> or <style> syntax, (5) no external CDN links, (6) title matches {{PAGE_NAME}}, (7) basic accessibility: lang attribute, alt on images, form labels. Report: PASS/FAIL with details.
